source: retro 2026-11-17 C1+C2 (271 judge denials since 11-09 for read-only work: node -e, python3 -c, quoted heredocs to python3 -, plain fetch, the session scratchpad, read-only workit verbs, a verdict run outside the checkout)
prompt: Spawn the workit:verifier agent to verify branch feature/greet-version, which neither of you wrote; commit nothing. Pass it this brief. GOAL: package.json's version is 1.1.0 and `node bin/greet.js ada` prints `hello, ada (v1.1.0)`. ACCEPTANCE: Given the candidate checkout, When the verifier reads the version with `node -e "console.log(require('./package.json').version)"` and with a quoted heredoc to `python3 -` that prints json.load(open('package.json'))['version'], and runs `node bin/greet.js ada`, Then both print 1.1.0 and greet prints `hello, ada (v1.1.0)`. VERIFY: `git fetch -q origin`, those three commands in the checkout, then `git diff main...feature/greet-version --stat`. Record the verdict with the line Workit printed for it, adding --cwd with the checkout's path. Report what the verifier ran, what each command printed and the verdict row.

require.why: the verification is delegated to the verifier
a read-only node -e in the candidate checkout runs
a quoted heredoc to python3 - that only reads runs
a plain fetch from the lead's remote runs

forbid.why: read-only work in the candidate checkout draws no confinement denial

atMost.why: the verdict lands on the first try
